$comment: OmniClean cleanup taxonomy - the single source of truth for both editions. The web engine (targets.ps1) and the native engine (OmniClean.Engine.cs / OmniClean.Resolvers.cs) both read this list, so a category can never exist on one side only. test/smoke.test.js asserts both editions stay in sync.

$kinds.paths: Explicit folder or file list. Wildcards: '*' matches inside one path segment, '**' matches any number of segments.
$kinds.glob: Discovery by pattern. roots[].base is a folder, roots[].patterns are relative patterns ('*' = one segment, '**' = any depth).
$kinds.recycle: The Recycle Bin of the active drive.
$kinds.empty_dirs: Empty directories below the temp roots.
$kinds.browser_cache: Every installed browser (Chromium, Gecko, Opera, Vivaldi, Arc, WebView2) - discovered, not hard-coded.
$kinds.gpu_cache: Graphics caches of every vendor - discovered, not hard-coded.
$kinds.old_app_versions: Versioned application builds; every root except the newest build is pruned.
$kinds.editor_cache: Caches of installed code editors (VS Code, Cursor, Insiders, ...).

$cleanupModes.contents: Delete everything inside the resolved folder (default).
$cleanupModes.icons_only: Delete only the thumbnail / icon cache database files inside the resolved folder.

$flags.requires_admin: The target usually needs Administrator rights to be cleaned.
$flags.opt_in: The target is not selected automatically. It can contain data that has to be downloaded again, so the user has to pick it explicitly.
